fullPassage: Unfortunately, many people don't take personal responsibility for their own growth. Instead, they simply run the race laid out for them. They do well enough in school to keep advancing. Maybe they manage to get a good job at a well-run company. But so many think and act as if their learning journey ends with college. They have checked all the boxes in the life that was laid out for them and now lack a road map describing the right ways to move forward and continue to grow. In truth, that's when the journey really begins. When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary. Like healthy eating habits or a regular exercise program, you need to commit to it and devote thought, time, and energy to it. Otherwise, it simply won't happen — and your life and career are likely to stop progressing as a result.

questions.passage: Unfortunately, many people don't take personal responsibility for their own growth. Instead, they simply run the race laid out for them. They do well enough in school to keep advancing. Maybe they manage to get a good job at a well-run company. But so many think and act as if their learning journey ends with college. They have checked all the boxes in the life that was laid out for them and now lack a road map describing the right ways to move forward and continue to grow. In truth, that's when the journey really begins. When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary. Like healthy eating habits or a regular exercise program, you need to commit to <u>it</u> and devote thought, time, and energy to it. Otherwise, it simply won't happen — and your life and career are likely to stop progressing as a result.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: it = your growth(여러분의 성장): 'commit to it and devote ... to it'에서 앞 문장의 your growth를 가리킴
det.analysis:
✅ ① 여러분의 성장: 앞 문장 'your growth becomes voluntary' 이후 'you need to commit to it'에서 it은 your growth(성장)를 지칭 ←정답

❌ ② 좋은 직장: it의 선행사는 growth

❌ ③ 정해진 경주: it의 선행사는 growth

❌ ④ 건강한 식습관: 식습관은 성장에 전념하는 방식을 설명하는 비유일 뿐
det.tip: your growth becomes voluntary → commit to it (it = your growth)

det.korean: 빈칸: '자발적인 것이 된다(becomes voluntary)' — 학교가 끝난 후 성장의 성격
det.analysis:
❌ ① disappears right away(곧바로 사라진다): 본문은 성장이 계속되어야 한다고 함 — 불일치

❌ ② stays exactly the same(똑같이 유지된다): 성격 변화를 설명하는 맥락과 다름

❌ ③ is decided only by teachers(교사가 결정한다): 본문은 스스로의 책임을 강조 — 불일치

✅ ④ becomes voluntary(자발적인 것이 된다): 'When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary'에서 성장이 자발적이 된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: your growth becomes voluntary — 성장은 자발적인 것이 된다
